Each runner reports CPU, memory, disk and agent state every minute.
A run fails: the service hook calls the Function App, which queues it.
The agent reads every failed step's log, the runner's health and its own logs.
Rules decide the cause; the AI adds a checked second opinion and drafts a fix.
Diagnosis and fix plans are saved; the developer is emailed signed approval links.
A person approves one plan in the dashboard or on the email link's page.
The approved plan runs: a pull request and proving run, or a runner fix, then a re-run.
Every minute the timer checks the re-run and emails whether the pipeline passed.
